headline: CPU post-trained DSV4-Flash diverges from GPU reference on ~18% of next-tokens (teacher-forced, same prefix, same position, from token 1) -> REAL correctness bug, not bf16 noise. Localized to the CPU PREFILL ATTENTION-CORE path; MoE/C-kernels/rope/projections/softmax-scale EXONERATED by hard parity.
harness_validated: GPU + our harness on Flash-Base = 0.923 (1211/1311) vs published 0.908 -> harness is CORRECT; the low CPU number is not a harness artifact.

exonerated_with_evidence.C_kernels: CPU-eager-vs-GPU 0.822 == CPU-C-vs-GPU 0.818 -> bug is in the CPU COMMON path, not the wired C kernels. CPU-C vs CPU-eager per-layer = gradual accumulation (cos 0.9999->0.98), no cliff.
exonerated_with_evidence.MXFP4_MoE_kernel: in-situ kernel-vs-fp4-oracle cos=0.999997; e8m0 scale path correct; LUT/nibble match sglang authority
exonerated_with_evidence.MoE_overall: CPU FP4->bf16 MoE (independent of MXFP4 kernel) vs GPU = 0.821 == MXFP4 0.818 -> MoE fully exonerated
exonerated_with_evidence.rope_application: KROPE_SHADOW cos=1.000000 maxerr=0 (kernel rope == independent complex-multiply); YaRN freqs_cis computed by shared device-agnostic sglang precompute_freqs_cis
exonerated_with_evidence.fp8_projections: FP8_PARITY cos=1.000000 (q/k/kv/o proj fp8 W8A16 == torch block-dequant)
exonerated_with_evidence.softmax_scale: self.softmax_scale = head_dim**-0.5 in shared model code (deepseek_v4.py:665), no mscale on either side; flash_mla applies no internal mscale -> identical CPU/GPU

ruled_out_artifacts.position_offbyone: shift-0 agreement 0.822, all other shifts ~0.01 -> alignment correct
ruled_out_artifacts.greedy_amplification: teacher-forced removes it; divergence from position 1
ruled_out_artifacts.cross_build_per_layer_capture: INVALID tool: GPU-vs-CPU layer cosine ~0 + 50x-250x magnitude = different capture semantics across the two sglang builds (container vs venv), NOT a model signal

remaining_suspects: QK-norm RMS scope (nope-only vs full - flagged ambiguous in KROPE comment)

key_deductions.sparse_selection_is_noop_here: at ~1130-token ctx with index_topk=512 over ~9-280 compressed blocks, top-k selects ALL -> DSA sparse selection cannot be the bug at this context length; the divergence is in DENSE attention math
key_deductions.divergence_is_prefill: the teacher-forced capture is a single prefill forward; rope+proj (prefill-active) are clean -> the bug is in the prefill attention core, not decode-specific

next_decisive_test: ATTN_SHADOW with MAX_NEW>=2 (job 391271): batched MLA vs reference loop self-consistency; if it diverges, the attention-core impl is self-inconsistent. Then build an independent layer-0 attention reference to compare vs GPU.

TRIAGE_BREAKTHROUGH_version_confound.finding: The CPU-vs-GPU comparison was NEVER version-controlled. CPU plugin built on sglang 0.5.20.dev373; GPU reference runs container sglang 0.5.22.
TRIAGE_BREAKTHROUGH_version_confound.nature: Only 7 dsv41 refs in 0.5.22 backend -> the ~2000-line growth is the V4 path ITSELF (new compress ratios 1/2, forward_low_ratio_sources, new flashmla scheduling), not V4.1 additions. DSV4 attention support was immature in 0.5.20 and substantially reworked by 0.5.22.
TRIAGE_BREAKTHROUGH_version_confound.both_use_V4_path: checkpoint model_type=deepseek_v4 (not v41); container is_dsv41=False -> both run the V4 path, so V4.1 is NOT the issue; the V4 attention CODE differs by version
TRIAGE_BREAKTHROUGH_version_confound.reframe: The 18% divergence localizes to the attention backend -- the exact subsystem that changed 2x between our 0.5.20 base and the 0.5.22 reference. So the divergence is heavily confounded by (and plausibly largely caused by) the version gap, NOT proven to be a CPU-plugin logic bug. Earlier 'CPU has a real bug' was OVER-ATTRIBUTED: never version-matched.
TRIAGE_BREAKTHROUGH_version_confound.decisive_calibration: run upstream 0.5.22 natively on CPU (device=cpu, no plugin) if it works -> CPU-0.5.22 vs GPU-0.5.22 is version+code matched = pure hardware signal. If ~100%, divergence enters via plugin/0.5.20; if ~82%, inherent.
TRIAGE_BREAKTHROUGH_version_confound.implication: The honest path may be to REBASE the CPU port onto sglang 0.5.22 (the matured DSV4 attention) rather than hunt a 'bug' in the 0.5.20-based port.

version_matched_proof.GPU-0.5.20_vs_GPU-0.5.22: 0.9775 (first_div ~64-80) -> sglang VERSION effect is only ~2%, benign/late; the 2577-line backend rewrite barely changes V4-path outputs
version_matched_proof.CPU-0.5.20_vs_GPU-0.5.22: 0.818 (first_div pos 1) -- same as matched -> version NOT the cause

corrected_conclusions: RETRACTED: the 'version-confound' triage. Two GPU versions agree 97.8%; version explains only ~2% of the divergence, not the 18%.
CONFIRMED + version-controlled: a REAL ~16% CPU-plugin divergence from GPU (82% vs the 97.8% GPU-vs-GPU floor), from POSITION 1, in the CPU MLA attention core.

It is a shared-blindspot defect: every CPU-internal parity probe passes (rope cos=1, proj cos=1, MoE 0.999997) yet CPU differs from GPU -> CPU matches its OWN oracle but not the authoritative computation.
DEFINITIVE_CALIBRATION.next: Build an INDEPENDENT (non-CPU-oracle) attention reference from the authoritative model math to break the shared blindspot and localize the attention-core defect (batched MLA algorithm / QK-norm scope / fp8-KV precision).
